description: Add a Customer Managed KMS Key with key rotation enabled and use it to encrypt all SQS Queues and SNS Topics in the stack
steps: In lib/example-project-stack.ts, add an import for aws-cdk-lib/aws-kms
Create a new kms.Key construct with enableKeyRotation: true. Give it a logical ID like 'ExampleProjectKey' and optionally add an alias and description for clarity.
Update both SQS Queue constructs (ExampleProjectQueue1, ExampleProjectQueue2) to add the 'encryptionMasterKey' property pointing to the KMS key
Update both SNS Topic constructs (ExampleProjectTopic1, ExampleProjectTopic2) to add the 'masterKey' property pointing to the KMS key

Update the tests in test/example-project.test.ts to verify: (1) A KMS Key resource exists with EnableKeyRotation: true, (2) The SQS Queues reference the KMS key for encryption (KmsMasterKeyId is set), (3) The SNS Topics reference the KMS key for encryption (KmsMasterKeyId is set)
Run 'npm run build' to verify TypeScript compilation passes
Run 'npm test' to verify all tests pass
Run 'npx cdk synth "**"' to verify cdk-nag AwsSolutions checks pass with the encryption in place
acceptance_criteria: A KMS Key with enableKeyRotation: true exists in the stack
All SQS Queues are encrypted with the Customer Managed KMS Key
All SNS Topics are encrypted with the Customer Managed KMS Key
npm run build compiles without errors
npm test passes with all tests green including new encryption tests
npx cdk synth passes without cdk-nag errors
